alex: Morning — quick async standup for sales: pipeline updates + enterprise security asks. Post 1-liners: what you did yesterday / blockers / focus today. I'll start: closed 3POC with Orion, waiting on SOC2 scope from legal. Blocker: onboarding KMS questions from MacroHealth (see below). Today: prep demo w/ Kernal at 11am. @sophie can you share status on KMS answers? :coffee:

sophie: ping — KMS doc draft done, pasted link: https://redwood.app/notes/kms-integration-draft. Waiting on eng-security for key rotation detail. FYI asked about HSM rotation SLA, they said 30 days max but will confirm. :eyes:

devin: Pipeline — new RFP from NovaGrid, sent estimated timeline (4–6 weeks) and pricing. Blocker: needs dedicated capacity note for SSO and VPC. Today: follow up with solutions eng to get SSO checklist and sample contract language.

raj: Quick sec ask from Cornerstone — legal wants encryption-at-rest diagram and CMK ownership wording. I uploaded a short diagram to drive: https://drive.redwood/diag/enc-at-rest. Blocker: need confirmation if customer-managed key allowed for Dedicated. @maria any changes on that policy?

maria: Confirmed earlier memo: Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via KMS, but Private (on-prem) needs different onboarding steps. I'll share a policy snippet in the docs channel and link it here. Looping @eng-security.

eng-security:bot: New ticket created: SEC-4821 "Clarify CMK support for Dedicated" — assignee: nadya. ETA: 2 business days. Link: https://issues.redwood/SEC-4821

nadya: Taking SEC-4821, will dig into docs and get back by EOD. Initial note: product supports bring-your-own-key per contract, but there are caveats around backup/escrow and rotation; will confirm specifics.

sophie: Also MacroHealth asked for HSM attestation report — do we have a templated response? If not, need infra to share attestation artifacts. @infra-team any pointers? :wave:

infra-team: We have an attestation bundle for Dedicated customers enrolled in compliance. We'll DM the template and checklist to sophie and alex.

alex: Thanks all. Actionable items: nadya -> SEC-4821 (EOD), maria -> policy snippet, sophie -> attestation follow-up w/ infra, devin -> SSO checklist with SE. If anything escalates, drop it here or ping me. Short update by 3pm? :thumbsup:

sophie: Noted, will update here by 1500.

devin: Will sync with SE and post checklist by 3pm PST.

raj: Adding email draft for Cornerstone to this thread: `Hi team — attached enc-at-rest diagram and proposed CMK wording. Please confirm if CMK ownership language is acceptable or if you need contract language changes.` I'll paste the draft link after feedback.

alex: Cool — closing loop. If anyone needs me I'm in meetings until 10:30 but will be on Slack after. :spiral_calendar:
